wonder.en: So, what's going on there? Well, that's something that the listeners of BBC World Service programme CrowdScience also wondered.
wonder.zh: So, what's going on there? Well, that's something that the listeners of BBC World Service programme CrowdScience also wondered.

wonder.en: I was wondering, can I have a nap in one of these beds?
wonder.zh: 我想问一下，我能在这些床上睡个午觉吗？

wonder.en: And so, I wonder whether that might make people more shy of speaking to strangers – worried that the people will, you know, not appraise them in a good way, and so doing something like this to try to counter that might feel like a positive step to people, that they're trying to do something.
wonder.zh: 所以我在想，这是否会让大家更羞于与陌生人交谈——担心别人对自己的评价不高。因此，通过做这样的事情来对抗这种心理，大家可能会觉得是一种积极的尝试，至少说明他们在做出努力。

wonderful.en: Hello, hello, hello, and welcome to English Learning for Curious Minds, by Leonardo English, the show where you can listen to fascinating stories and learn weird and wonderful things about the world at the same time as improving your English.
wonderful.zh: 大家好，欢迎收听由 Leonardo English 制作的《English Learning for Curious Minds》。在这个节目中，你可以一边收听引人入胜的故事、了解世界上奇妙而不可思议的事物，一边提升你的英语水平。
